text: Manual syntax proposal for the inspected OpenPGP send path: use the existing SIGN and ENCRYPT aliases when expressing the signed/encrypted decision, and keep the mode predicate close to the encoding action. Those names convey the bit meaning in a compound condition. Keep the prose comment aligned with every real exception, including GPGME signing and unobtrusive signatures. This is a local readability proposal beyond formatting; it is not evidence that all constants or bit tests in Thunderbird must use these two short names.
title: Use named send flags for a compound crypto mode decision
